03 History | | Cultural reputation archetypes including exacting Eldar etiquette | 02 Peoples | 10 Rules | | Autumn Day 21 supper and Autumn Day 22 inspection, witness reports and experiments | 13 Chronicle | 12 Mysteries for interpretation and research tracking | ## Known material discrepancies requiring specific treatment ### 1. Day 19 character age — retroactive canon correction Creator's explicit retcon: Gloin Hammerfeld has been 42 since the very first Autumn Day 19 scene, and his younger brother Tovin is 34. The original canonical World Bible and previous Compendium hub were directly corrected; the opening record in the current Chronicle also uses 42. Any older inconsistent age text in an uneditable archived chat is an obsolete drafting error, not an alternate canon or an in-world age change. The accepted sibling order remains Bruni 57, Gloin 42, Tovin 34, Elska 26. ### 2. Silence Below dating — unresolved anchor Both the historical Bible and newer historical reference preserve the Deep Resonance → Unlit Halls → Final Sealing sequence, with rough numerical markers of 3,240, 3,190 and 3,160 years respectively. The older entry calls these years ago while other text calls them years before the Seven Thrones. This may reflect an imprecise narration, but its intent has not been verified. Treat the anchor as disputed until clarified; do not create precise converted calendar years. ### 3. Money model — explicitly superseded The existing four-denomination model supersedes the earlier restriction to two. Current world rate: 100 copper to one silver, 100 silver to one gold, 100 gold to one platinum. Continue all recorded Gloin purse amounts without inventing conversions or expenses. ### 4. Mine investigation roster — planned vs observed The named planned Maela/Edrik/Captain Vale party and the actual Maela/Rennik/Feldin/Orsa/Gloin observed group are different kinds of record. An unexplained change in reported participants is neither a factual error nor proof of an agenda. Do not collapse them into a single list. ### 5. The western wall and reported breach Edrik's claim of a breach and something crossing it is a reported allegation. Independent watchmen's knock/scrape/whisper/hum details and the actual non-invasive masonry examination do not prove what caused them. Keep the separate speakers and instrument limitations intact. ### 6. Subjective Deepcraft sensations The vivid experience of a response or welcome at Maela's pale-grey granite cannot be rewritten as established sentience, family recognition, ancestral magic, a living mountain, an ancestor, or an entity. Gloin's wording is part of the character's experience; a theory about its mechanism is open. ### 7. Additional nine peoples and unapproved names Nine additional peoples have explicit established-canon standing with remaining unresolved traits. Talarin, Khevari, Nerathi, Thallin and Cindari are not canon. Older proposals or archetypes must not override the user's later acceptance/rejection. ### 8. Original Bible family and society notes worth preserving The Hammerfeld house's precise location, condition, size and whether Gloin still has a room are unknown. Ordinary family affection, practical support and disagreements do not establish wealth, serious estrangement or major debt. Society frameworks in the Bible encompass funeral and household customs, ancestor rites, religious institutions with possible charitable/educational roles, military veterans, recruitment, training, wages and regional rank systems. These are worldbuilding possibilities, not pre-written named local institutions. ### 9. Campaign start-to-pause completeness The Chronicle now includes the opening at Day 19 7:20 AM, detailed recovered scene sequencing through the Day 19 9:38 AM first conversation with Hadrik, a separately recovered workshop meeting through Day 19 3:06 PM, the first documented Day 20 6:15 AM scene, and the independently preserved Day 21–22 entries. Midday/afternoon Day 19 transitions and nearly all further Day 20 scenes remain incomplete; this is not yet a fully reconstructed transcript. The source set cannot prove that every earlier spoken line, transaction, image, encounter, training step or choice was incorporated. The user export may supply missing prior chat history. Treat this as a coverage limitation, not a licence to reconstruct Gloin's actions by imagination. ### 10. Earlier historical character count A figure of roughly 160,000 characters was reportedly given for an earlier version. The currently fetched original Bible page has approximately 106,000 characters including its source wrapper, depending on measurement method. The historical version cannot be inferred from the difference. Await export before making claims about deleted material or the precise older length. ## Research tasks and exact evidence to preserve during future edits - Hadrik: identify the obscured third name in Varric's repository access register; assess original register and possible safe access.
